observations: The page number «78» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01: «Cotangente ist“» ends the quotation of Abū’l-Wafāʾ begun on p. 77 (JP2 0109, L33-L35). L07-L08 and L23-L24: the headings of chapters 29 and 30-30a, in bold, centred, each with the reference to the text below it; «30a», the a raised; L07 «elbuht» in the bold of the heading.

L09-L13: «el-buht», «bhukti», «buht» in italics; the Sanskrit bhukti, enjoyment, the daily motion of a planet. N03: the English of Burgess's translation in italics, «enjoyed» letter-spaced in the italics.

L14-L22. Checked: the hourly true motions are symmetric about the mean ones: the sun 2′ 28″ ± 6″ (the mean 2′ 27″ 50‴, p. 65, JP2 0097, L21), the moon 32′ 56″ ± 2′ 44″; 2′ 27″ 50‴ × (1 ∓ sin 2° 14′) = 2′ 22.0″ and 2′ 33.6″, with the greatest solar equation of p. 45 (JP2 0077, L07). Al-Battānī's values follow from his eccentricity of the sun, 2p 4¾′, and his lunar epicycle of 5p 15′ (p. 46, JP2 0078, L05): 2′ 27.8″ × 60 : 62;4,45 = 2′ 22.9″ and × 60 : 57;55,15 = 2′ 33.1″; 32′ 56″ − 32′ 40″ · 5;15 : 65;15 = 30′ 18.3″ and 32′ 56″ + 32′ 40″ · 5;15 : 54;45 = 36′ 4.0″, the hourly motion in anomaly being 32′ 40″ (p. 24, JP2 0056). The values of Tables 61-66 are to be compared with the tables.

L15: the degree sign of «0°» is printed broken, open on its right side; L30: a dark blot over the first i of «dimi-»; L29: a speck after the full stop of «bestimmen.»; not transcribed. L21: «(l. c.)», al-Battānī's table of II, 88 (note 5).

The dashes: L08 «61—66» (35 px) and L24 «22—23» and «61—66» (36 and 44 px) in the small type of the references; L16 «61—66», L17 «0°—180°», L18 «360°—180°», L29 «0°—180°» and L30 «61—66» the long dash of the text (41-50 px), set close.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Carra de Vaux», «Abū’l-Wefā», «Batt.», «Kh.», «Ulūgh Beg», «Burgess», «Nallino»; italics: «el-buht», «bhukti,», «buht», «semitae numerorum», «quantitas rotae solis,», «rotae lunae.», «dimidium rotae solis vel lunae», «täglichen», the titles of N01, «Sūrya-Siddhānta», the English of N04-N05.
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (10-13 px measured; «p. 158 :» in N04, 12 px).
